what: A video slot hidden at width 0 between big lines of text (height 1.18em, corner radius .17em) opens from its own center to 2.1em wide with scrub .8, from when the element’s top edge hits 94% of the screen until its bottom edge hits 55%. It pushes the neighboring words aside (the .12em gaps on both sides open too). The video inside is at full size from the start, so it isn’t squashed while opening — only the window widens

options.w: Width of a fully opened cell (css length), default 2.1em — also via --fx-w
options.--fx-h · --fx-gap · --fx-radius: Cell height · side gap · corner radius (css variables), default 1.18em · .12em · .17em

use: FROM 0TO 100

from.where: index.html .svc-big (first service line) — original #svcIntro --hv 0→1 scrub .8, start top 94% · end bottom 55%

note: With two or more cells, all spread with the same progress (the original also uses one value). Set text lines to white-space: nowrap so lines don’t overflow, or reduce the cell width.
